_about: Rule-based pillar tagging from caption text. First matching rule wins (top to bottom). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions tested against the full caption. This is a labelling aid, not a reviewed taxonomy: edit rules here, then run refresh.py. Posts matching nothing become 'Other'.
